chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

q1_what_did_you_play: I played Nereid's Ascension first, hitting all enemies, then All Streams Flow to the Sea targeting Leaf Slime (M).
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered Nereid's Ascension followed by Coral Guard, trading damage on Leaf Slime (M) for enough Block to cover the telegraphed 4-damage attack.
q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up 5 Block and the option to gain Charge and summon Bake-Kurage in order to maximize immediate damage.
q4_different_intent: Yes. A substantially larger attack intent would have made me use Coral Guard after Nereid's Ascension instead of All Streams Flow to the Sea.
